mission: DEEP-RESEARCH the utility source landscape (water / wastewater / electric) for all 28 launch-footprint counties and their principal cities. FIND WHAT A DILIGENT HUMAN WITH A SEARCH ENGINE FINDS. Probe/research only: no store writes, no roster edits, no rail proposals. Never synthesize a hostname.
l10_failure_mode: Catalogue-driven only. Hosts already pinned in recon notes. Returned NOT-FOUND-UNKNOWN-WHY for most of the footprint, including cities that OWN their electric utility (Austin Energy, CPS Energy, Denton Municipal Electric, Georgetown Utility Systems, Garland GP&L, Greenville GEUS).
operator_standard: A verdict without its rung list is invalid. Run ALL rungs R1-R6 before any not-found verdict.

utility_use.LAYER-FOUND: queryable public layer OR download product OR viewer-unwrapped service, verified by returnCountOnly plus groupBy or center/corner probe — never advertised name/extent alone
utility_use.AUTH-WALLED: utility GIS exists behind login/agreement/CEII. First-class honest verdict. Never credential-guess, never scrape behind a login.
utility_use.HOST-BROKEN: discovered host down or Application Error
utility_use.ORDINANCE-NO-GIS: provider requires service letter / no public GIS (honest terminal)
utility_use.NOT-FOUND-UNKNOWN-WHY: ALL rungs R1-R6 ran; still no positive determination. Must list rungs_ran.
utility_use.SERVICE-LETTER-REQUIRED: product terminal where line-level truth is withheld; maps onto ORDINANCE-NO-GIS for product copy; record both when that is the honest answer

discovery_ladder.R1: WEB SEARCH, multiple phrasings: '<city> GIS open data', '<city> water utility map', '<city> ArcGIS rest services', '<city> utility open data', '<utility name> GIS'. Follow the results. Discovered URLs from search are allowed (that is finding, not guessing).
discovery_ladder.R2: ARCGIS ONLINE SEARCH API (www.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/search): find the city's/utility's AGOL org and hub by name; enumerate its feature services with utility keywords AND by browsing the org's full service list (name-keyword search alone is the /zon/ trap).
discovery_ladder.R3: OPEN-DATA PORTAL DISCOVERY: Socrata discovery API + data.<city>.gov, <name>.opendata.arcgis.com, CKAN instances. Directory lookups — allowed and expected.
discovery_ladder.R4: WEBMAP UNWRAPPING: when a city or utility exposes a public interactive utility viewer, fetch the webmap/app item JSON (f=json) and extract the operational layers' service URLs. A public viewer is a public service pointer.
discovery_ladder.R5: UTILITY-OWNED PORTALS, not just city portals. Known municipal-electric owners in footprint: Austin Energy, CPS Energy (San Antonio), Denton Municipal Electric, Georgetown Utility Systems, Garland GP&L, Greenville GEUS. Water: SAWS, Austin Water, Dallas Water Utilities, Fort Worth Water. Plus co-ops (Bluebonnet, Pedernales, Oncor public layers) and river authorities (LCRA, Brazos).
discovery_ladder.R6: STATE INVENTORIES beyond PUCT REST: TWDB water service boundary viewer + asset datasets; TCEQ downloads; ACTUALLY DOWNLOAD the PUCT sewer CCN zip from puc.texas.gov/industry/water/utilities/gis.aspx and report its contents; TxGIO DataHub; COG holdings (NCTCOG for the DFW footprint counties, not just CAPCOG/H-GAC).
discovery_ladder.R7: Only after R1-R6: the honest typed verdict.

verify_rule: Every found layer: returnCountOnly=true where=1=1 PLUS a groupBy on a county/utility field when present OR a center/corner geometry probe. Never advertised name/extent alone. HTTP timeout 30s. No pagination storms. No hostname synthesis.

prediction.statement: At least HALF of L10's NOT-FOUND-UNKNOWN-WHY rows for cities over 50,000 population flip to LAYER-FOUND, viewer-backed service, download product, or AUTH-WALLED under this ladder.
prediction.grade_style: ZCHAL — if the result lands outside that band in either direction, say so plainly. A refuted prediction is data.
prediction.denominator_rule: L10 county x utility cells whose status is NOT-FOUND-UNKNOWN-WHY AND whose principal_city or also[] includes a Census 2023-estimate place with population >= 50000.
prediction.note: Rockwall city 2023 estimate is ~50.8k; L10 named Rockwall as principal. Held OUT of the locked denominator to avoid a borderline inflate; if Wave 2 finds a flip it is recorded as extra, not counted against the 15/30 bar. Johnson/Burleson is IN (Burleson is in L10 also[] and is >=50k).
